question: How can I track my order?
answer: Open My Orders, pick the order and tap 'Track'. You will see the courier name, tracking number and live status.
variants: What is the status of my order?
Order ka status kaise dekhe?

question: How long does a refund take?
answer: After we receive and check the returned item, refunds reach UPI and wallets in 1-3 working days and cards or net banking in 5-7 working days.
variants: When will my money come back after a return?
Refund aane mein kitna time lagta hai?

question: I have not received my refund yet, what should I do?
answer: First check the expected date in My Orders > Refund status. If that date has passed, raise a 'Refund not received' ticket from the order page and share your bank statement if asked.
variants: My refund has not reached my bank account
Refund nahi mila abhi tak

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Go to My Orders, choose the item and tap 'Return'. Pick a reason and a pickup slot; keep the item packed with its tags and invoice.
variants: I want to send back something I bought
Return kaise karte hain?

question: How many days do I have to return an item?
answer: Most items can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Electronics have 7 days and some items such as innerwear cannot be returned; the product page shows the exact window.
variants: What is your return period?
Kitne din tak return kar sakte hain?

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Open My Orders, select the order and tap 'Cancel' before it is shipped. After shipping you can refuse the delivery or return it later.
variants: Please cancel my order
Order cancel karna hai

question: Can I change the delivery address after placing an order?
answer: Yes, until the order is shipped: open the order and tap 'Change address'. Once shipped, the address cannot be changed.
variants: I entered the wrong address, can I fix it?
Delivery address badal sakte hain kya?

question: Is cash on delivery available?
answer: Cash on delivery is available for orders up to Rs 50,000 on most pincodes. The checkout page shows if COD is available for your address.
variants: Can I pay when the product is delivered?
Cash on delivery milta hai?

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking, DemoMart Wallet, EMI and cash on delivery.
variants: How can I pay for my order?
Kaise pay kar sakte hain?

question: Do you offer no-cost EMI?
answer: No-cost EMI is offered on selected products with partner bank cards for 3, 6 or 9 months. Eligible products show a 'No-cost EMI' tag.
variants: Can I buy on EMI with zero interest?
Zero interest EMI milega?

question: What are the delivery charges?
answer: Delivery is free on orders above Rs 499. Smaller orders have a Rs 40 delivery charge; DemoMart Plus members always get free delivery.
variants: Is shipping free?
Shipping ka charge kitna hai?

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Metro cities usually get orders in 1-3 days and other areas in 3-7 days. The exact date is shown at checkout.
variants: When will my order be delivered?
Order kitne din mein aayega?

question: How can I check if you deliver to my pincode?
answer: Enter your pincode on any product page under 'Deliver to'. It shows whether we deliver there and the expected date.
variants: Is delivery available at my location?
Kya mere area mein delivery hai?

question: How do I exchange a product for a different size?
answer: Open My Orders, choose the item and tap 'Exchange', then pick the new size. Exchange is free and the new item is delivered when the old one is picked up.
variants: Can I swap my item for another size?
Size badalna hai, kaise karu?

question: What should I do if I received a damaged product?
answer: Raise a return within 48 hours from My Orders, choose 'Damaged item' and upload photos of the product and the box. We will arrange a replacement or refund.
variants: My product arrived damaged
Saman kharab haalat mein aaya

question: What if I received the wrong item?
answer: Raise a return within 48 hours from My Orders and choose 'Wrong item received'. We pick it up for free and send the correct item or a refund.
variants: I got a different item from what I ordered
Order kuch aur aaya hai

question: How do I apply a coupon code?
answer: On the cart page tap 'Apply coupon', type or choose the code and tap 'Apply'. The discount appears before you pay.
variants: How do I use a discount code?
Coupon kahan apply kare?

question: Why is my coupon code not working?
answer: Check the coupon's minimum order value, expiry date, eligible products and whether it is limited to one use per account or to some payment methods.
variants: The coupon is not getting applied
Promo code kyun nahi chal raha?

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page tap 'Forgot password' and enter your registered mobile number or e-mail. Use the OTP to set a new password.
variants: How do I set a new password?
Password reset karna hai

question: How do I change my registered mobile number?
answer: Go to Account > Profile > Mobile number, enter the new number and verify it with the OTP sent to both the old and the new number.
variants: I want to change my phone number
Mobile number update kaise kare?

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Account > Settings > Delete account. Accounts with open orders or a wallet balance must settle those first; deletion is permanent after 30 days.
variants: How can I close my DemoMart account?
Account band karna hai

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Yes. Payments are processed by PCI-DSS certified gateways and saved cards are stored as tokens, so DemoMart never stores your full card number.
variants: Is it safe to pay on DemoMart?
Payment safe hai kya?

question: Payment failed but money was deducted. What should I do?
answer: Don't worry: a failed payment is automatically reversed by your bank within 5-7 working days. If it is not reversed by then, raise a ticket with the transaction ID.
variants: Money was cut from my account but the payment shows failed
Account se paise gaye par order fail hua

question: How do I get an invoice for my order?
answer: Open My Orders, select the order and tap 'Download invoice'. Invoices are available once the item is delivered.
variants: How do I get the GST bill for my order?
Invoice download kaise kare?

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Not at the moment. DemoMart delivers only to addresses in India.
variants: Do you deliver outside India?
International shipping hai kya?

question: How do I contact customer care?
answer: Use Help > Chat with us in the app, or call 1800-000-0000 (toll free, 8 am to 10 pm, all days).
variants: What is your customer support number?
Helpline number kya hai?

question: What is the warranty on electronics?
answer: Electronics carry the brand's manufacturer warranty, usually 1 year. The product page lists the warranty and the brand service centre details.
variants: Do electronic products come with a warranty?
Warranty kitne saal ki hoti hai?

question: Can I buy gift cards?
answer: Yes. DemoMart gift cards from Rs 100 to Rs 10,000 can be bought under Account > Gift cards and sent by e-mail or SMS.
variants: Do you sell gift vouchers?
Gift card milta hai kya?

question: How do I become a seller on DemoMart?
answer: Register at the DemoMart Seller Hub with your GSTIN, PAN and bank account. After verification you can list products and start selling.
variants: How can I sell my products on DemoMart?
Seller account kaise banaye?

question: Do you have a membership with free delivery?
answer: Yes, DemoMart Plus costs Rs 999 a year and gives free and faster delivery, early access to sales and extra cashback.
variants: What is DemoMart Plus?
Plus membership ke fayde kya hain?
